integrity: Algebra and probability arguments are provided with exact finite-field block counts, proof of all asymptotic error bounds, and exhaustive finite prime-field checks. Independent mathematical auditing is not performed.
scientific_limitations: The new asymptotics concern fixed q and dimension n tending to infinity, for structure matrices uniform on GL_n(F_q); no sparse or isomorphism-uniform ensemble is covered. Source graph criteria are credited; broader matrix-pattern literature could contain equivalent bounds.
title: Two exponential scales for simplicity and indecomposability in random perfect evolution algebras
